units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 29:12">Lev. R. s. 29</cite> (ref. to <he>בחדש</he>, <cite ref="Psalms 81:4">Ps. LXXXI, 4</cite>) <he>תְּחַדְּשׁוּ מעשיכם</he> ye shall polish (cleanse) your doings.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 78:16">Gen. R. s. 78</cite>, beg. (ref. to <cite ref="Lamentations 3:23">Lam. III, 23</cite>) <he>אתה מְחַדְּשֵׁנוּ וכ׳</he> thou renewest our lives every morning; <he>אתה מח׳ לבוקרן וכ׳</he> thou inspirest us with new life in the morning (rise to power) &c., v. <cite ref="B01138"><he>בֹּקֶר</he></cite>; a. fr.

<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 7a:17">R. Hash. 7ᵃ</cite>, a. e. (ref. to <cite ref="Numbers 28:14">Num. XXVIII, 14</cite>) <he>חַדֵּשׁ והבא וכ׳</he> commence a new account and offer T’rumah of the new produces.

senses.gloss: to promulgate a new law, to establish a new interpretation of a Biblical law; to find a new point.
units: Sabb. 104ᵃ, a. fr. (ref. to Lev. XXVI, 46) אין נביא רשאי לְחַדֵּשׁ וכ׳ (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) since the promulgation of these laws no prophet has a right to issue a new law. Y. Erub. V, 22ᶜ bot. it is called the New Gate, because there חִידְּשׁוּ וכ׳ (not חו׳) the Sof’rim instituted the interpretation (Halakhah); a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be renewed, to be established as a new interpretation (cmp. Lat. novellae); to be offered as a new point (דבר חדש). Y. Yeb. VIII, 9ᶜ top (ref. to I Chr. VIII, 9) שעל ידיה נִתְחַדְּשָׁה הלכה וכ׳ at her instance the new interpretation (of the law Deut. XXIII, 4) was established; Midr. Sam. ch. XXII; Ruth R. to II, 5 כבר נ׳ הלכה the law has been interpreted long before.
units: <cite ref="Sotah 3b">Sot. 3ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>לא נשנית אלא בשביל דבר שנ׳ בה</he> the section is repeated for the sake of a new point added.
<cite ref="Yoma 26a:10">Yoma 26ᵃ</cite> <he>משמרות מִתְחַדְּשׁוֹת</he> the Temple attendants are relieved.
